commands: v=$(aws ssm get-parameter --name /op-deckbuilder/dev/firebase/api_key --region us-west-2 --query Parameter.Value --output text 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$v" ] && echo "FIREBASE_API_KEY=$v" >> /opt/app/.env

v=$(aws ssm get-parameter --name /op-deckbuilder/dev/firebase/auth_domain --region us-west-2 --query Parameter.Value --output text 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$v" ] && echo "FIREBASE_AUTH_DOMAIN=$v" >> /opt/app/.env

v=$(aws ssm get-parameter --name /op-deckbuilder/dev/firebase/project_id --region us-west-2 --query Parameter.Value --output text 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$v" ] && echo "FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID=$v" >> /opt/app/.env
v=$(aws ssm get-parameter --name /op-deckbuilder/dev/firebase/app_id --region us-west-2 --query Parameter.Value --output text 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$v" ] && echo "FIREBASE_APP_ID=$v" >> /opt/app/.env

v=$(aws ssm get-parameter --name /op-deckbuilder/dev/firebase/service_account_json --with-decryption --region us-west-2 --query Parameter.Value --output text 2>/dev/null | jq -c . 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$v" ] && printf 'FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON=%s\n' "$v" >> /opt/app/.env
